Big shift in the AI world: OpenAI is now testing ads inside ChatGPT for users on the Free and new “Go” tiers, starting in the U.S., with a broader rollout planned after feedback.

Here’s what that actually means.

Ads will appear at the bottom of responses, clearly labeled as “Sponsored.” They’re designed to be highly relevant to your conversation. For example, if you’re discussing travel plans, you might see hotel or flight suggestions. If you’re exploring productivity tools, you could see related software recommendations. The idea is contextual placement rather than random display advertising.

Importantly, Plus, Pro, and Enterprise tiers remain completely ad-free. Users can opt out of personalized ads. There will be no political or health-related ads, and users under 18 won’t see ads at all. Conversations remain private — OpenAI states that personal chat data isn’t sold, and only aggregated performance metrics are shared with advertisers.

So why make this move?
